component: LOS 1-sigma Cramér-Rao formal phase-noise lower bound
colormap: viridis (dark/purple = lower sigma, bright/yellow = higher sigma; NaN transparent)
looks_source: Nominal 16 azimuth x 13 range = 208 looks from docs/gunw_structure.md (/science/LSAR/GUNW/metadata/processingInformation/parameters/unwrappedInterferogram/frequencyA)
method: Per-pair phase std via Cramér-Rao / Rodriguez & Martin (1992): sigma_phi = sqrt(1 - gamma^2) / (gamma * sqrt(2 * L)), converted to LOS cm via (lambda / (4 * pi)) * sigma_phi * 100, and summed in quadrature across N consecutive provisional pairs: sigma_total = sqrt(sum(sigma_d_i^2)). Pixels masked per cumulative.py (coh >= 0.3, conncomp != 0, finite unwrapped phase in all pairs).
assumptions: Uses nominal multilooking L = 208 (16 azimuth x 13 range looks inspected in docs/gunw_structure.md for CV 4000_SH; parameterizable via --looks).

If RSLC spectral weighting, oversampling, geocoding bilinear resampling, or 20 MHz mode (2000_SH at Karapinar) lowers effective independent looks to L_eff = 100, all sigma values scale up by sqrt(208/100) = 1.442x (reported in sensitivity_L100).
Assumes statistically independent interferometric pair noise summed in quadrature (sqrt(N) scaling).

DOES NOT INCLUDE ATMOSPHERE: captures short-scale thermal/decorrelation phase noise ONLY; excludes spatially correlated tropospheric wet-delay turbulence (~1-3 cm/pair), elevation-ramp residuals, and phase-unwrapping errors.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
